North-Western Problems Research Society - meeting

Six committee members of the North-Western Problems
Research Society held a meeting in their office in the
Chinese Y.M.C.A., 123 Boulevard de Montigny, at 6.30 p.m.
May 4, with Mr. Ling Kong-hou ( 林康侯 ) presiding. The
following resolutions were passed :-

1) That Mr. Huang Tsing-wei ( 黃警頑 ) be appointed as
executive secretary in place of Mr. Li Dah-tsao( 李大超 ),
who has gone to Canton.

2) That Mr. Pan Niang-yao ( 潘仰堯 ) be appointed to
arrange with the publishers of the Dah Kung Pao for
the publication of articles written by members of the
Society.

西北问题研究会——会议

5月4日下午6时30分，西北问题研究会的六名委员在蒙梯尼路（Boulevard de Montigny）123号中华基督教青年会内的该会办公室举行会议，由林康侯先生主持。通过以下决议：-

1) 任命黄警顽先生为执行秘书，以接替已前往广州的李大超先生。

2) 任命潘仰尧先生负责与《大公报》出版商接洽，刊登该会会员撰写的文章。

Chinese Cultural Building Society entertains Tribal
Leader from Southwest Border Provinces

A reception for Miss Kao Yu-zu ( 高 玉 柱 ) and
Mr. Yu Chieh-zai ( 喻 杰 才 ), tribal leaders from the
Southwest Border provinces was held by the Chinese
Cultural Building Society, 500 Rue Lafayette between
7 p.m. and 10.30 p.m. February 6 in the Huchow Club,
263 Kweichow Road. Thirty two persons including
Mr. Ian Kung-chai, Commissioner of the local Bureau of
Social Affairs attended.

Miss Kao Yu-zu and Mr. Yu Chieh-zai held a tea
party between 3 p.m. and 6 p.m. February 7 in the Kwan
Sung Yuan Restaurant, 457 Nanking Road. Approximately
sixty guests representing various local public bodies
and newspapers attended.

Report of Establishment of Poison Gas Factory in China

A report entitled "The Shanghai Political Society
and other organizations send circular telegrams
protesting against the opening of poison gas establishments
in China by a 'certain' country" has been distributed
among local news agencies through the post. The report
states that a large factory for the manufacture of poison
gas will be established in Tientsin by that 'certain'
country and that branches will be organized in Shanghai

高玉柱小姐和喻杰才先生于2月7日下午3时至6时，在南京路457号冠生园餐厅举行茶话会。代表当地各公共团体和报社的大约六十位宾客出席。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
S. U. REGISTRY
S. L. D. 703/
Date 21 /10 35

Central Registry,
October 17, 1935.

To
H. E. Aiers Esquire,
Central Registrar.

Sir,
Reference attached, might I suggest that
the following translation be adopted:-
"The office of the "Study of North-West
Problems Association" has been removed to the
2nd Floor, Chinese Y.M.C.A. Building, French
Concession, Tel. 85284, where the office of
the "Shanghai Subscription Team" of the China
National Aviation Association is accommodated."

Y. O. S.

Translator.

P.A.
It would seem that official Translator
has made a clerical error
CR 7/10
pages.zh:
上海公共租界工部局警务处
S. U. 登记处
S. L. D. 703/
日期 21 /10 35

中央登记处，
1935年10月17日。

致
H. E. Aiers 先生，
中央登记官。

先生，
参照附件，我建议采用以下译文：-
“‘西北问题研究会’办事处已迁至法租界中华基督教青年会大楼二楼，电话85284，此处亦为中国航空协会‘上海征集团’办事处所在地。”

Y. O. S.

译者。

P.A.
看来官方译者出现了一处笔误
CR 7/10
